create_logger: create a Logger instance with a logging directory to store pickled agent data
setitem_logger_data: set key-value pairs in a Logger instance to store data for later checkpointing
log_to_file: log a Logger's data dictionary to a pickled file at a given iteration number
check_logging_enabled: check whether a Logger instance has logging enabled or disabled
cleanup_stale_logs: automatically remove stale log files older than CHECKPOINT_DURATION iterations
